name: Sherry Bristol
original_name: シェリー・ブリストル
source:
Sherry Bristol is Eonia's closest supporter and commander of the Elsior Pursuit Force. A serious, highly capable and extremely loyal woman; Sherry accompanied Eonia even after he was exiled from the Transbaal Empire.

[From [url=http://galaxyangel.wikia.com/wiki/Sherry_Bristol]Galaxy Angel Wiki[/url]]
